name: Fund and bond losses offset share gains, a fund's after the partial exemption
workings: The salary is taxed as in employee-75k: 13,935.657745
Equity ETF: loss 4,000.00, 70% after the partial exemption, which applies to losses too (§20 InvStG; BFH VIII R 15/22): 2,800.00
Bond: loss 1,000.00. Both are in the general pot, which offsets any capital income, share gains included (§20 Abs. 6 Satz 3)
Shares: gain 5,000.00 − 3,800.00 = 1,200.00; less the 1,000 allowance: 200.00; flat tax 25% = 50.00; Soli 2.75
Nothing is left to carry forward
